consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at the Assembly Hall on February 22, 1973, highlighting the exceptional jamming and musicianship throughout the show. The Dark Star > Eyes of the World sequence, along with standout versions of Playin' in the Band and Bird Song, are frequently mentioned as highlights, showcasing the band's creativity and synergy during this period.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 45 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The strong consensus on the quality of the performance and the standout moments leads to a significant positive adjustment from the neutral baseline.
